primary_sources.locator: Meng et al., Rethinking Transfer in Continual Learning: A Replay-Based Realisation, arXiv:2607.15587
primary_sources.pressure: Transfer-Selective Replay makes compatibility of prior tasks a first-class condition for replay benefit, reinforcing the need to gate negative history by compatibility rather than replay indiscriminately.

primary_sources.locator: Dorovatas et al., Modular Memory is the Key to Continual Learning Agents, arXiv:2603.01761
primary_sources.pressure: Modular memory is an established parent direction for experience accumulation and adaptation; storing negative history is not by itself a new ORION primitive.

primary_sources.locator: De Sabbata, Sumers and Griffiths, Rational Metareasoning for Large Language Models, arXiv:2410.05563
primary_sources.pressure: Value-of-computation already formalizes selecting extra reasoning/computation when its expected decision value justifies cost, reinforcing #477 as the parent for decision-relevant query choice.

rounds.challenge_neighborhood: failure-driven agent improvement + trace diagnosis + safety-scoped repair

primary_sources.locator: Sun et al., Learning from Failure: Inference-Time Self-Improvement for Computer-Use Agents, arXiv:2606.31270
primary_sources.pressure: Failed trajectories can materially improve later agent behavior, reinforcing the usefulness of failure history but not supplying scientific scope/transport/refutation authority.

primary_sources.locator: Chen et al., From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents: Diagnosing and Repairing Harness Flaws, arXiv:2606.06324
primary_sources.pressure: Trace-aware responsibility localization and scoped repair of harness layers are strong parents for turning failure evidence into bounded repair actions rather than broad global changes.

primary_sources.locator: Yin, Li and Wang, On-Policy Self-Evolution via Failure Trajectories for Agentic Safety Alignment, arXiv:2605.11882
primary_sources.pressure: Verifier-scored failure trajectories can drive corrective supervision while preserving multiple safety/utility objectives, reinforcing failure-data usefulness under external verification rather than a new failure ontology.

interpretation: The refresh strengthens the parent decomposition: selective replay owns compatibility, modular memory owns experience storage, metareasoning owns decision-relevant compute/query value, trace diagnosis owns scoped responsibility/repair, and failure-driven self-improvement establishes that failures can be useful. None adds a new coordinate that defeats the frozen STANDARD_PARENT composition or creates an ORION-specific general failure-learning primitive.
reopen_rule: A later primary source that demonstrates a reusable scientific failure-learning capability not representable by scoped nogood/responsibility + semantic transport + decision-relevant inquiry under matched information/resources reopens the candidate terminal and resets both rounds.
